items.title: No secrets manifest is tracked, .env.local is gitignored, and the removed Kubernetes folder stays gone
items.oracle_cmd: ! git ls-files | grep -q 'medemap-secrets.yaml' && git check-ignore -q .env.local && ! test -d Kubernetes && ! git ls-files | grep -q '^Kubernetes/'

items.title: No hardcoded Cesium Ion JWT in tracked files
items.oracle_cmd: ! git ls-files -z | grep -zv bun.lock | xargs -0 grep -lE 'eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9\.eyJqdGkiOiIx' 2>/dev/null | grep -q .

items.title: OpenShift manifests, Argo Application and DB resource are accepted by the API server (server-side dry-run); Dockerfile has a non-root user and no secrets
items.oracle_cmd: oc get ns medemap >/dev/null && oc apply --dry-run=server -f openshift/medemap.yaml -f openshift/db/medemap-database.yaml -f argocd/medemap.yaml >/dev/null && grep -q '^USER 1001' openshift/Dockerfile && ! grep -rIE --exclude=create-secrets.sh --exclude=check-public-safe.sh 'eyJhbGci|PASSWORD=.{4,}' openshift argocd

items.title: Readiness probe reports ready iff the database answers SELECT 1 (was always 503: called a Redux thunk as a function)
App DB role medemap_app is read-only (plus log INSERT); owner role cannot log in; PUBLIC cannot connect
items.oracle_cmd: d=$(mktemp -d) && cp openshift/db/app-role.test.mjs "$d/test.mjs" && (cd "$d" && npm init -y >/dev/null 2>&1 && npm i @electric-sql/pglite >/dev/null 2>&1 && node test.mjs "$OLDPWD/openshift/db/app-role.sql" >/dev/null)

items.title: Auth gate no longer matches every path; /api/llm needs a session, clamps model/tokens, rate limits, hides upstream errors; /api/metrics needs a token; log endpoint input is bounded
items.oracle_cmd: bunx jest lib/security app/api/llm app/api/metrics app/api/health

items.title: Deployment has read-only root, no service-account token; NetworkPolicy restricts ingress to the tunnel and egress to DNS, Postgres, 443, Ollama
items.oracle_cmd: grep -q 'readOnlyRootFilesystem: true' openshift/medemap.yaml && grep -q 'automountServiceAccountToken: false' openshift/medemap.yaml && grep -q 'kind: NetworkPolicy' openshift/medemap.yaml && oc apply --dry-run=server -f openshift/medemap.yaml >/dev/null

items.title: AI assistant is gated by one shared AI_ACCESS_KEY (constant-time, per-IP lockout, rate limits); the dialog shows the contact email for requesting a key (no form, no mail sending); model is gpt-6.1-sol; public status endpoint leaks nothing
items.oracle_cmd: bunx jest lib/security lib/ai app/api/llm app/components/AIAccessModal && ! test -e app/api/request-access/route.ts && ! test -d lib/mail

items.title: Tracked/unignored files carry no private (tailscale/LAN) addresses, no personal email, and no secret values, so the repo can be public
No critical/high advisory against the version of any request-serving dependency (next, next-auth, @auth/core, axios, pg, js-yaml, ...); xlsx and @types/axios removed
Login throttling and timing-equal checks, profile-id path traversal closed, no internal error text in responses, security headers on every response, unused /api/loopbacktest removed
items.oracle_cmd: bunx jest lib/auth lib/profiles lib/security app/api/profiles && ! test -e app/api/loopbacktest/route.ts
